title: Dobricii
description: Wedding platform built on Next.js and Supabase, with a Gemini-powered seating assistant that rearranges tables on request, fuzzy-matched RSVPs with conflict resolution, and a full admin panel. Planned up front and built in Claude Code under close review.

title: CarHeltau
description: Contract automation for a car dealer, built as two custom WordPress plugins: one generating PDF contracts from validated multi-step form submissions, the other wiring up Revolut payments with order status verification.

title: Fota Industrial
description: B2B presentation site for industrial equipment, built on Wix — catalogue structure, content setup and SEO.

title: Cursed Vision Films
description: Video architecture and speed work for a cinematography studio's Next.js site: database-backed media storage, a custom player for unlisted YouTube embeds with no ads or recommendations, and an admin panel where pasting a link publishes a video instantly.

title: bioRO
description: Startup platform where buyers scan a QR code to trace how the food they're buying was produced. Built with Next.js and Firebase, with QR scanning straight in the browser.

title: Leida
description: Landing page for a premium HoReCa equipment supplier, on a custom WordPress child theme with an interactive GeoJSON map of Romania plotting the company's cities. No longer in use.

title: Wedding website
description: Bilingual Vue app I built for my own wedding: guests uploaded photos and videos, and left messages that were saved as PDFs in a shared space.

title: Priv
description: Real-time private messaging app for exactly two people, built with Flutter and Supabase, with media sharing, video compression and thumbnail generation.

title: HeltauLeads
description: Internal lead engine for a car dealer: a Playwright scraper collects listings, classifies each seller, drafts a matching Romanian WhatsApp opener, and syncs everything to a Google Sheet behind a React dashboard.
